newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta airport 18 mth oper profit $1.06 mln.
newsitem.headline: Malta airport 18 mth oper profit $1.06 mln.

text.p: State-owned Malta International Airport company on Tuesday announced an operating profit of Maltese lira (Lm)382,066 ($1.06 million) in the 18 months to March 1996.
It gave no comparative figures for the previous 18 month period but had earlier announced a profit of Lm640,056 ($1.7 million) for the 12-month period ending in September 1994.
MIA chairman Nick de Giorgio said fixed prices, especially an airport passenger charge unchanged since 1988, were the main reason for the fall.
Profit after tax for the 18 month period was Lm64,871. In the 12-month period upto end September 1994 the figure had been Lm191,992.
De Giorgio said that in the 18 months, 40,810 aircraft landed or left the airport carrying 3.5 million passengers.
The company said the review of the 18 month period was done to align it with other state companies.
